findings.summary: L3/L4 validity binding is not enforced on the recovery path. HumanRecoveryExit supports validity_digest but control_plane.recover never supplies one, _load_recovery_exit drops persisted validity_digest, and HumanRecoveryExit.resume only checks target_ref and does not re-measure or compare the current validity key. Consequently a recorded recovery decision can resume work after the product, SPEC, acceptance context, target, or PR identity has changed, bypassing the required invalidation and safe recovery behavior.
